scope: Pi Testnet production-only exact 0.10 DR11 automatic refund certification flow
root_cause: Settlement Stage-1 could create/persist an A2U Pi identifier in the narrow window before DR11 Refund authority became durable. Refund authority then correctly excluded Settlement, while DR69 correctly refused a projection carrying an A2U identifier, leaving the lifecycle safely but functionally deadlocked.

candidate_requirements: checkpoint is pending/intent_created with refund authority source state
Redis source state is paid_to_app with only an A2U identifier
external_reproof: durable completed U2A identity is re-proven
PostgreSQL authority must show Refund active and Settlement inactive
exact Pi A2U PaymentDTO must match paymentId, merchantUid, amount, network and direction
unmoved A2U identifier is cancelled through Pi /payments/{id}/cancel
exact A2U is re-read and must be CANCELLED_UNMOVED before Redis CAS repair
existing_orphan_recovery.redis_repair: compareAndSwapPaymentProjection only after cancellation proof; repaired projection removes orphan A2U identifier and restores strict refund_pending source shape
existing_orphan_recovery.uncertainty_policy: BLOCK / retry later; no refund authorization from uncertainty

customer_ui.terminal_success: green warning plus final refund receipt fields
